name: TextBox 18
text:
ABSTRACT
XPoSat’s POLIX payload records polarization-sensitive scattering information across multiple Level-2 FITS products. The proposed study aims to transform exposure, energy–azimuth, timing, detector-balance and source-azimuth behaviour into interpretable features for unsupervised observation screening when trusted anomaly labels are unavailable. Product-aware explanations will connect unusualness to original FITS products, while WeightedRoll and blank-sky comparison remain an independent physical diagnostic. The expected contribution is a traceable workflow for expert prioritization—not source classification. Statistical unusualness is not a discovery, and calibrated polarization degree or official sky polarization angle is outside the present claim without validated background treatment and mission calibration.

name: TextBox 56
text: The proposed study introduces a product-aware, explainable framework for POLIX Level-2 observations. It aims to inventory the observation bundle, extract scientifically interpretable features from exposure, energy–azimuth, timing, detector and source-azimuth products, and apply justified unsupervised methods to rank unusual observations. Each screening result is intended to include feature-level evidence and a link back to the original product family. WeightedRoll and blank-sky behaviour form an independent physical diagnostic. The final output supports researcher prioritization and cautious interpretation; it does not classify source types or claim a discovery.

name: Title 7
text: ARCHITECTURE EXPLANATION

name: Rectangle: Rounded Corners 1
text:
The diagram represents the proposed Review-I workflow.

1. Observation bundle — treats each POLIX observation as related Level-2 FITS products.
2. Validation — checks expected files, dimensions, units and missing-data conditions.
3. Interpretable representation — summarizes exposure, energy–azimuth, timing, detector balance and source-azimuth behaviour while retaining provenance.
4. Unsupervised screening — uses PCA or clustering for justified exploration, then ranks relative unusualness without assigning source classes.
5. Product-aware explanation — identifies contributing features, reference differences and the source product to inspect.
6. Researcher review — presents traceable evidence for prioritization.

Independent branch: WeightedRoll and blank-sky modulation are examined separately. The framework does not claim calibrated PD, official PA or discovery.
